Core Active Vocabulary (5 items):

can — to be able to do something. Example: I can swim.
speak — to say words. Example: I can speak Spanish.
little — a small amount. Example: I can speak a little German.
student — a person who studies. Example: I am a student in an English class.
class — a group of students who learn together. Example: My class is at nine.
Essential Chunks & Functional Collocations:

• I can speak a little ...
• I can understand ... quite well.
• I am a student in ...
• My progress is good.
• How well can you ...?
